result.description: Compact desktop note display designed for ambient reading, task lists, and low-power room signage. The Aurora Quill uses a monochrome E-Ink panel with front light adjustment, wireless syncing, and a built-in stand for portrait or landscape use. Intended for quiet offices, studios, and bedside setups rather than gaming or high-performance computing. Features include USB-C charging, multi-day battery life, and support for simple text, calendar, and checklist layouts.
result.title: Aurora Quill 14-inch E-Ink Note Display
